Hello sensei! I would like to ask for the same 2 characters as last time please! 

Character 1 (Jade Crow): A boy who used to live on the streets before getting hired by Yingfei (2). He is very cynical and reserved because he saw how cruel humans are. He is polite on the surface and smiles easily, but is a short-tempered man inside. Please draw him in clothes A (first image in the reference.)  

Character 2 (Yingfei): A wealthy and beautiful young man who is always smiling. He is very clever and selfish even though he looks polite. He is also very spoiled and lazy too because of his upbringing. (Please draw him in his updated outfit.) 

Relationship: Character 1, Jade Crow, is a vigilante hired by Character 2 (Yingfei), a wealthy young man, to do odd jobs for him. Jade (1) dislikes Yingfei’s sly and arrogant nature, but he helps him because he is poor. Ying Fei (2) likes to tease Jade (1). They are both very competitive with each other and like to banter (with words) a lot, though usually Jade gets annoyed and leaves Yingfei.   

The setting is Ancient China. Themes include crows (or birds), lilies and lily pads, willows, liquor, jewelry, leaves, nighttime, and water. I can list a couple of ideas, but sensei can draw a different prompt if you have other ideas!! They could be on a bridge looking at the river beneath them. They could be attending a lantern festival but only watching from afar as lanterns fly up. Here is a link to more inspiration: https://www.pinterest.com/hanamiicchi/jade-crow-yingfei/  

Feel free to appeal or cancel if inappropriate. Thank you!

・名前　テオドール
・19歳　男
・こげ茶のくせ毛・健康的な肌色、深緑色の少したれ目
・172ｃｍ　60㎏
・性格　おっとりとしたのんびり屋、誰にでも優しい。喧嘩や争いごとが苦手でパンを作ったり木工をしたりするのが好き。恋愛事には鈍い。
